author: Diego Sandoval
title: Carlos Duran added to Dodgers' 40-man roster
desc: Carlos Duran was added to the Los Angeles Dodgers' 40-man roster on Monday.
impact: Duran has been an impactful reliever for Triple-A Oklahoma City this season, boasting a 3.86 ERA and striking out 50 batters in 35 innings of work. The 6-foot-7 right-hander has made just one appearance at the MLB level in his career, a one-out outing for the Athletics in 2025.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Chuckie Robinson designated for assignment
desc: Chuckie Robinson has been designated for assignment by the Los Angeles Dodgers.
impact: Robinson was originally sent down to Triple-A, but he has now been designated for assignment in a corresponding move to Carlos Duran being added to the 40-man roster. Robinson struggled to find offensive consistency as a backup catcher in LA, going 2-for-23 in his eight games played.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Eder released by Dodgers
impact: Eder will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Gervase optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Dodgers optioned Paul Gervase to Triple-A Oklahoma City.
impact: Gervase returns to Triple-A to make room for Evan Phillips.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Evan Phillips (elbow) activated from IL
desc: The Dodgers activated Evan Phillips from the injured list.
impact: Phillips returns from the 60-day injured list. He'll be eased back into a high-leverage role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chas McCormick signs minor league deal with Cubs
desc: The Cubs signed Chas McCormick to a minor league contract.
impact: McCormick has an .801 OPS in Triple-A this season. He'll add outfield depth for the Cubs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Edman (foot/ankle) not in lineup Monday
desc: Tommy Edman is not in the Dodgers lineup on Monday against the Rockies.
impact: Edman was scratched from Sunday's lineup due to soreness in his right foot/ankle. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Cavalli has suspension reduced to five games
desc: The MLB has reduced Cade Cavalli's suspension from seven games to five games.
impact: Cavalli will begin serving the suspension on Monday. He'll be eligible to return for Sunday's game right before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ian Hamilton sent outright by Braves
desc: The Braves sent RHP Ian Hamilton outright to Triple-A Gwinnett.
impact: Hamilton will remain in the Braves organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Davis Wendzel released by Pirates
desc: The Pirates released INF Davis Wendzel.
impact: Wendzel went unclaimed on waivers after being designated for assignment. He'll seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hurston Waldrep to start Tuesday
desc: Hurston Waldrep will start Tuesday's series opener against the Pirates.
impact: Waldrep allowed three runs over 5 1/3 innings against the Cardinals last week. He'll be worth a look as a streamer in deeper leagues.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Fleming signs minor league deal with Cubs
desc: The Cubs signed LHP Josh Fleming to a minor league contract.
impact: Fleming was most recently released by the Blue Jays. He'll add pitching depth in the Cubs organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adrian Del Castillo optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks optioned C Adrian Del Castillo to Triple-A Reno.
impact: Del Castillo returns to Triple-A with James McCann activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: James McCann (quad) activated from IL
desc: The Diamondbacks activated C James McCann from the 10-day injured list.
impact: McCann missed the past seven weeks with a quad strain. He'll return to a backup role behind the plate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Anderson designated for assignment
desc: The Red Sox designated Jack Anderson for assignment.
impact: Anderson loses his spot on Boston's 40-man roster to make room for Patrick Sandoval. He will head towards waivers.
